name: Perception & Detection
purpose: Turn camera imagery into calibrated person / heavy-machinery / PPE detections. Owns the YOLO inference wrapper, the detection-frame geometry contract, the training and dataset tooling, and the detector evaluation harness.

public_interfaces.name: ConstructionSafetyDetector.detect
public_interfaces.contract: Returns native-frame boxes with class name, confidence, PPE flags; never raises on an empty frame.

public_interfaces.name: frame_calibration geometry (geometry_for / scale_boxes / to_native / iou)
public_interfaces.contract: Letterbox geometry between native and inference frames; every overlay coordinate is expressed in native pixels.

public_interfaces.name: detector weight resolution
public_interfaces.contract: SENTINEL_DETECTOR_WEIGHTS points at a loadable checkpoint; missing weights degrade to an explicit unavailable state rather than a crash.

acceptance_criteria: Detector loads a checkpoint and returns person/machinery/PPE boxes on a native frame.
Boxes survive the native -> inference -> native round trip within 1 px.
Detector evaluation script reports precision/recall against the restored ground truth.
No import of the FastAPI gateway, the agentic layer or database state from this project.
risks: Weights are large binaries: yolov8n.pt and weights/yolo26n.pt are tracked, so a future repository split must use LFS or a model registry.
Dataset splits under data/construction_safety are synthetic/demo samples; they validate plumbing, not site accuracy.
Ultralytics and torch are the heaviest runtime dependency in the platform; this project is the reason the CPU image is large.
